title: INCA Jev × GPT decision economics — original recorded 20-case development sample
data_quality: 20 developer-authored synthetic travel cancellation pairs, 10 authored attention true / 10 attention false. Not independent expert labels. Guard-assisted replay is contaminated by known development failures.
caveats: Pricing is a dated public-list-price estimate, not provider invoice.
Jev and GPT have different token usage; compare complete prices, not input rate alone.
All pricing excludes extraction, OCR, provider plans, infrastructure, retries, downstream models, and human time.
A flagged 'needs_attention' case may require information collection rather than human review.
Do not extrapolate this artificial 50% positive-case mix as real insurance prevalence.
